title: Kristiansten Fortress
geometryBasis: Native building footprints 17693566, 89642573, 474662465 and 95714848, mapped retaining-wall ways, exact public-domain images reviewed alongside Forsvarsbygg’s conservation register, and sampled original hillside elevation.
sectionBasis: The upper keep is a three-storey white limewashed masonry donjon, with a grey fully hipped slate roof and splayed small openings. Bastion walls are battered rough stone with planted crests. Lower support buildings use white cladding, red tile on the commandant’s residence, and grey roofing on the magazine.
limitations: Bastion crest and backfill levels and the Donjon’s section are interpreted from the map, terrain and exterior photographs. The model covers the principal group and preserves the outline of the angular fort. Interiors and detached equipment are outside the model.
